title: Add provider-owned Claude invalid-store quarantine
body:
## Summary

- add `/amux-claude`-owned quarantine plan/apply/inspect for `receipt_store_invalid_or_unavailable`
- bind exact origin/provider/store evidence/artifact manifest/owner authorization and permit only exact worker `park`
- preserve invalid provider evidence and keep quarantine visibly unresolved
- fail closed on evidence drift, conflicting replay, malformed metadata, and interrupted park outcomes

## Safety boundaries

- core amux remains provider-neutral
- apply invokes only the ordinary exact `amux worker park --thread <origin>` action after adjacent provider preflight
- no teardown, remove, archive, catalog detach, provider cleanup, retirement, or `no_pair` conversion
- tests use only synthetic state and an injected park executor; no provider or physical lifecycle action was run

## Validation

- focused quarantine test
- full `/amux-claude` package tests
- `go test ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- full gofmt check
- Python syntax compile
- `./scripts/build-amux.sh /tmp/amux-issue-280`
- `git diff --check`
- focused privacy scan
- Oracle read-only blocker review and post-fix re-review

Related to #280.
